name: Feishu Workspace
description: Optional Feishu web workspace and official document API tools. Browser login and API authorization are separate.

workspace-url.title: Feishu workspace URL / 飞书工作区网址
workspace-url.description: HTTPS Feishu page opened by the ribbon. Web login works independently of API setup. / 侧栏打开的飞书网页；网页登录与 API 授权相互独立。

token-kind.title: API identity / API 身份
token-kind.description: user: user_access_token enables document search. tenant: tenant_access_token supports authorized docx reads/writes only. / user 支持搜索；tenant 仅支持有权限的新版文档读写。

access-token.title: Feishu access token / 飞书访问令牌
access-token.description: Stored by the OS credential service; sent only to open.feishu.cn. Supply an authorized user_access_token or tenant_access_token matching API identity. Replace it when expired; no automatic OAuth refresh. Never enter an App Secret here. / 由系统凭据服务保存，仅发送到 open.feishu.cn；令牌过期后需替换。请勿填写 App Secret。

interface.shortDescription: Feishu web page and explicit document search, read, create and edit tools.
